best_idea: When an encounter ends, sort every drop into safe (taken home regardless), at risk (taken home only on a clean clear), or carried (stays with a surviving player), deciding by owner, then clear state, then place, not by a roll.
decision_why: Keep the three-bucket split and the at-risk-only-on-clean-clear gate as one server-side rule in src/fight/loot.ts, run once when a zone is cleared or left and writing ledger rows with a state. Do not copy the physical floor-item model: Frankendom loot is ledger rows on one ledger, and the exit area belongs in zone data.
acceptance: In a two-player zone fixture, the server ledger credits a drop lying in the zone only after a clean clear; a player who aborts leaves that drop uncredited while a drop held by a surviving player moves on to the next zone stage.
